arxiv-1703-05475.title: A quest to unravel the metric structure behind perturbed networks
arxiv-1703-05475.creator: Srinivasan Parthasarathy, David Sivakoff, Minghao Tian, Yusu Wang
arxiv-1703-05475.description: Abstract Graphs and network data are ubiquitous across a wide spectrum of scientific and application domains. Often in practice, an input graph can be considered as an observed snapshot of a (potentially continuous) hidden domain or process. Subsequent analysis, processing, and inferences are then performed on this observed graph.

arxiv-2103-10782.title: Microstructure evolution and tensile behaviour of a cold rolled 8 wt% Mn medium manganese steel Journal: Metall. Mater. Trans. A
arxiv-2103-10782.creator: T. W. J. Kwok, P. Gong, X. Xu, J. Nutter, W. M. Rainforth, D. Dye
arxiv-2103-10782.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. W. J. Kwok, P. Gong, X. Xu, J. Nutter, W. M. Rainforth, D. Dye. A novel medium manganese steel with composition Fe-8.3Mn-3.8Al-1.8Si-0.5C-0.06V-0.05Sn was developed and thermomechanically processed through hot rolling and intercritical annealing. The steel possessed a yield strength of 1 GPa, tensile strength of 1.13 GPa and ductility of 41%. In order to study the effect of cold rolling after intercritical annealing on subsequent tensile properties, the steel was further cold rolled up to 20% reduction.

arxiv-2207-09347.title: Optimization of broad gain and high optical nonlinearity of mid-infrared quantum cascade laser frequency combs
arxiv-2207-09347.creator: Martin Franckié
arxiv-2207-09347.description: Abstract Mid-infrared Quantum Cascade Lasers (QCLs) are compact and efficient sources ideal for molecular spectroscopy applications, such as dual-comb spectroscopy. However, despite over a decade of active developments of QCL frequency comb devices, their bandwidth is limited to around 100 100 cm -1 , severely limiting their application for multi-gas, liquid, and solid sensing.

arxiv-2211-02660.title: De novo PROTAC design using graph-based deep generative models
arxiv-2211-02660.creator: Divya Nori, Connor W. Coley & Rocío Mercado
arxiv-2211-02660.description: Abstract PROteolysis TArgeting Chimeras (PROTACs) are an emerging therapeutic modality for degrading a protein of interest (POI) by marking it for degradation by the proteasome. Recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI) suggest that deep generative models can assist with the de novo design of molecules with desired properties, and their application to PROTAC design remains largely unexplored.

arxiv-2312-07276.title: A Mixture-of-Gradient-Experts Framework for Accelerating AC Optimal Power Flow This work was partially supported by the 2023 CITRIS Interdisciplinary Innovation Program (I2P). All authors are with the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of California, Santa Cruz, USA.
arxiv-2312-07276.creator: Shourya Bose , Kejun Chen , and Yu Zhang
arxiv-2312-07276.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel data-driven constraint screening approach aimed at accelerating the solution of convexified AC optimal power flow (C-OPF) by eliminating non-binding constraints. Our constraint screening process leverages a novel mixture-of-experts architecture called MoGE (Mixture of Gradient Experts), which is trained to predict optimal dual variables based on problem parameters.

arxiv-2407-05604.title: A comparative study of ultraluminous infrared galaxies in the IRAS and SDSS Surveys
arxiv-2407-05604.creator: Shaohua Zhang (张少华), Zhijian Luo (罗智坚), Xiheng Shi (史习珩), Chenggang Shu (束成钢), Hubing Xiao (肖胡兵), Hongyan Zhou (周宏岩)
arxiv-2407-05604.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shaohua Zhang (张少华), Zhijian Luo (罗智坚), Xiheng Shi (史习珩), Chenggang Shu (束成钢), Hubing Xiao (肖胡兵), Hongyan Zhou (周宏岩). We present a comprehensive study of Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies (ULIRGs), leveraging data from the IRAS Faint Source Catalogue (FSC) and the spectroscopic catalog in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) DR16. Our meticulous cross-matching technique significantly enhances the reliability of ULIRG identification, resulting in the identification of 283 reliable ULIRGs, including 102 new detections, while discarding 120 previously reported false sources.

arxiv-2411-06378.title: PKF: Probabilistic Data Association Kalman Filter for Multi-Object Tracking
arxiv-2411-06378.creator: Hanwen Cao, George J. Pappas, Nikolay Atanasov
arxiv-2411-06378.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hanwen Cao, George J. Pappas, Nikolay Atanasov. In this paper, we derive a new Kalman filter (KF) with probabilistic data association between measurements and states. We formulate a variational inference problem to approximate the posterior density of the state conditioned on the measurement data.

arxiv-2502-06212.description: Abstract Computational disease modeling plays a crucial role in understanding and controlling the transmission of infectious diseases. While agent-based models (ABMs) provide detailed insights into individual dynamics, accurately replicating human motion remains challenging due to its complex, multi factorial nature. Most existing frameworks fail to model realistic human motion, leading to oversimplified and less realistic behavior modeling.

arxiv-2508-11544.title: Grand Challenge: Mediating Between Confirmatory and Exploratory Research Cultures in Health Sciences and Visual Analytics
arxiv-2508-11544.creator: Viktor von Wyl University of Zurich, Faculty of Medicine UZH Digital Society Initiative (DSI), Zurich, Jürgen Bernard University of Zurich, Department of Informatics UZH Digital Society Initiative (DSI), Zurich
arxiv-2508-11544.description: Abstract \color blackCollaboration between health science and visual analytics research is often hindered by different, sometimes incompatible approaches to research design. Health science often follows hypothesis-driven protocols, registered in advance, and focuses on reproducibility and risk mitigation. \color blackVisual analytics, in contrast, relies on iterative data exploration, prioritizing insight generation and analytic refinement through user interaction.

pmc-10648219.creator: Paula Ketilly Nascimento Alves, Antje Schauer, Antje Augstein, Anita Männel, Peggy Barthel, Dirk Joachim, Janet Friedrich, Maria-Elisa Prieto, Anselmo Sigari Moriscot, Axel Linke, Volker Adams, Raj Kishore
pmc-10648219.description: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a complex syndrome associated with a high morbidity and mortality rate. Leucine supplementation has been demonstrated to attenuate cardiac dysfunction in animal models of cachexia and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). So far, no data exist on leucine supplementation on cardiac function in HFpEF.

pmc-12516615.title: The association between food benefit online ordering and redemptions: evidence from the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children
pmc-12516615.creator: Junzhou Zhang, Chuanyi Tang, Kayoung Park, Qi Zhang
pmc-12516615.description: Objective:To examine how the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) online food benefit ordering could influence WIC benefit redemptions.Design:A cross-sectional study. We compare the average redemption rates between online ordering early adopters and non-adopters among WIC customers before and after implementing WIC online ordering. A propensity score-weighted difference-in-difference model was used to estimate the coefficients.

pmc-13083888.title: Long-term remote sensing assessment of Natura 2000 protected areas in Poland (2004–2023)
pmc-13083888.creator: Piejak Mateusz, Joanna Sender
pmc-13083888.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Protected areas are essential for safeguarding biodiversity, yet their long-term environmental trajectories and stability remain insufficiently quantified at the national scale. This study evaluates two decades (2004–2023) of satellite-derived environmental dynamics within Poland’s Natura 2000 Special Areas of Conservation (SACs) using Landsat-based indicators: NDVI (vegetation greenness), TC Wetness (surface moisture), NDBSI (surface exposure related to land transformation), and LST (land surface temperature).

pmc-13122529.title: Parental alcohol supply in early childhood and adolescent drinking: Evidence from a prospective cohort
pmc-13122529.creator: Albert J Ksinan, Pavla Brennan Kearns, Zuzana Mohrová, Zsófia Csajbók, Jana Klánová, Hynek Pikhart, Martin Bobák
pmc-13122529.description: BackgroundParental alcohol supply in early childhood may increase the risk of alcohol use in late adolescence. pmc-13408492.title: Development of AI based behavioral feature patterns on influencing asymptomatic cardiovascular disease attributes: a dataset standardization approach
pmc-13408492.creator: V. Sangeetha, Syed Muzamil Basha, Syed Thouheed Ahmed, Surbhi B. Khan, Mohammad Shabaz, Ali Algarni, Shakila Basheer
pmc-13408492.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) remain a major global health challenge, characterized by heterogeneous clinical attributes and multi-source data variability that limit reliable predictive modeling. Existing approaches primarily focus on independent feature analysis, often overlooking the interdependency between symptomatic and asymptomatic attributes. In this study, a transfer learning–based framework is proposed for cross-domain feature harmonization and interdependency-driven attribute modeling.

pmc-13437663.title: Platelets as regulators of anti-tumor immunity: mechanisms and clinical implications
pmc-13437663.creator: Martin Schlesinger
pmc-13437663.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Platelets are increasingly recognized as important contributors to tumor progression and metastatic dissemination. Platelets facilitate cancer cell survival, their safe transit through the hostile bloodstream, arrest at distant organ sites, and ultimate outgrowth into metastatic lesions. Although multiple platelet-dependent mechanisms have been implicated in cancer progression—including epithelial-mesenchymal transition and the provision of tumor-supportive growth factors—recent studies increasingly highlight immune modulation as a central mechanism underlying platelet-mediated metastasis.

pmc-13494105.description: The two-pore domain K+ (K2P) channel TALK-1 is a key regulator of β-cell electrical excitability, Ca2+ handling, and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.
